facts.text: Tim enjoys reading books, particularly a series that he describes as a magical world to escape to.

evidence.quote: In my downtime, I still love to get lost in good books, and this series is one of my favorites. It's a magical world to escape to.

facts.text: Tim has seen all the Harry Potter movies and finds it amazing to watch the story come alive on screen.

evidence.quote: Have you seen all the Harry Potter movies? I'm a fan too!
Yeah, I have! Watching them and seeing how they compare to the books is awesome. It's amazing to watch the story come alive.

facts.text: John has organized a basketball camp for kids in his hometown and describes it as an awesome experience.

evidence.quote: Organizing a basketball camp for kids in my hometown last summer was an awesome experience! Seeing their faces light up when they hit the court was priceless.

facts.text: John enjoys watching movies and finds it a great way to relax.

evidence.quote: I'm a total movie fan! Seeing it all come alive on the big screen is awesome, and a great way to relax.
